Risk: Unsafe first-aid instruction
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Unreviewed steps or peer practice
Prevention_and_Response: Qualified instructor checks every step and diagram; use mannequins/inert props; remove any unvalidated protocol
Required_Evidence: Signed dated clinical/safety review and instructor lesson plan

Risk: Unsafe jump-start or vehicle lifting
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Generic vehicle-independent procedure or unsupervised minor activity
Prevention_and_Response: Require exact vehicle and booster manuals, qualified technician, controlled environment and clear stop/call-help route; no HV or roadside practice
Required_Evidence: Specific-manual references; technician sign-off; photographed inert prototype checked
Gate: Before artwork, filming, trial or release

Risk: Food poisoning, burns or allergen exposure
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Recipe untested or allergy controls absent
Prevention_and_Response: Test recipe and all safety checkpoints; provide paper/no-food equivalent; no unsafe substitutions
Required_Evidence: Test records, allergen matrix and food-safety sign-off

Risk: Electrics, gas, tools or household chemicals misused
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Activity requires regulated work, mixing or uncontrolled heat/height
Prevention_and_Response: Keep hazardous work at recognise-stop-call scope; adult control of low-risk tools; specialist review
Required_Evidence: Risk assessment for each practical task and approved alternatives

Risk: Safeguarding or distress during sensitive lessons
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Forced disclosure, coercive role-play or no reporting route
Prevention_and_Response: Use fictional scenarios, opt-out/support alternatives, school-approved safeguarding routes and trained facilitator
Required_Evidence: Safeguarding protocol and content review

Risk: Children treated as unpaid product testers without protections
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Pilot recruitment lacks permission, assent or appropriate oversight
Prevention_and_Response: Seek school/legal route, parent permission where required and child assent; minimise burden; no grades or sales pressure
Required_Evidence: Approved information sheet, privacy basis and withdrawal process

Risk: False ministry or institutional endorsement
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Cover/marketing implies approval or partnership not granted
Prevention_and_Response: Use precise independently developed wording; keep curriculum alignment and official approval separate
Required_Evidence: Approved claims checklist and written permissions for any logo

Risk: School acquisition used as assumed revenue
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Budget relies on approved-list status or future policy expansion
Prevention_and_Response: Forecast trade and school channels separately; zero guaranteed school orders; only signed purchases enter committed cash
Required_Evidence: Quote-driven model and documented actual orders

Risk: Missed AZOO window or wrong submission format
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: No complete dossier near 31 March
Prevention_and_Response: Verify deadline and current delivery mode; readiness gate 3 weeks earlier; defer rather than rush
Required_Evidence: Current written checklist, final files and receipt

Risk: Wrong legal entity or retail/tax setup
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: ISBN registration mistaken for permission for ongoing sales
Prevention_and_Response: Accountant/counsel checks publisher, commerce, VAT, invoicing, consumer and privacy duties independently
Required_Evidence: Written setup decision and tested compliant checkout/invoice

Risk: Curriculum code mismatch across cycles
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Cycle-2 content marketed for all upper-primary grades
Prevention_and_Response: Use exact grade/cycle, distinguish combined codes, record partial coverage and teacher validation
Required_Evidence: Row-level curriculum matrix and sign-off

Risk: Policy forecast presented as enacted change
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Unconfirmed rollout, funding or finance-strategy successor stated as fact
Prevention_and_Response: Use dated status labels and source register; recheck before proposals; remove unsupported promises
Required_Evidence: Policy tracker reviewed at each commercial gate

Risk: Stale legal, money, travel or digital guidance
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Changed rates, laws, contacts or platform behaviour
Prevention_and_Response: Keep volatile data in dated adult notes; review before print and quarterly online; permanent errata route
Required_Evidence: Recheck log, version history and corrected dependent assets
Gate: Before every reprint and quarterly web review

Risk: Design readable for one age but not another
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: B1 too dense or B3 feels childish
Prevention_and_Response: Test three distinct ages with shared grid; vary density and illustration maturity, not identity
Required_Evidence: Reader observations and actual-size proofs

Risk: Inaccessible activities or family-income stigma
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Success requires equipment, money, reading speed or household disclosure
Prevention_and_Response: Give no-cost paper/oral/adapted paths; fictional budgets; include varied homes and abilities
Required_Evidence: Accessibility audit and support-needing reader feedback

Risk: Copyright or contract rights missing
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: No rights for illustration, font, photo, narration or reused form
Prevention_and_Response: Maintain licence/assignment ledger; verify territories, media, edits and source files; independent originality review
Required_Evidence: Signed contracts and asset provenance
Gate: Before any public sample or release

Risk: AI-generated technical errors or invented sources
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Unverified diagrams, procedures, laws or references
Prevention_and_Response: Human author/editor accountability; verify every source; specialist checks safety images; log AI assistance
Required_Evidence: Claim ledger and reviewer sign-off

Risk: Excess print stock and weak cash recovery
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Large print run justified only by low unit cost
Prevention_and_Response: Get 300/500/1000-copy quotes as scenarios; consider short run/POD feasibility; include freight, returns, deposit and damaged stock
Required_Evidence: Landed-cost model and approved capped exposure

Risk: Distribution discount erases margin
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Retail price ignores trade discount, returns, VAT or fulfilment
Prevention_and_Response: Model each channel separately; use net receipts and variable costs; reprice or reject uneconomic route
Required_Evidence: Channel contribution and break-even model using quotes

Risk: Companion scope delays first book
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: App, video or boxed deck consumes core-book budget
Prevention_and_Response: Launch book plus essential printable support; gate physical cards, audio, video and app on demand
Required_Evidence: Stage budget and explicit deferred backlog

Risk: QR dependency or link rot
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Required activity relies on third-party link/login
Prevention_and_Response: Publisher-controlled stable redirects; printed short code; downloadable archive and print alternative
Required_Evidence: Link checks, restore test and offline lesson test
Gate: Before print and monthly link check

Risk: Privacy breach or inappropriate analytics
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Child data, behavioural ads or unnecessary identity collection
Prevention_and_Response: No child accounts/ads by default; least data; processor contracts; retention and security review
Required_Evidence: Privacy inventory, consent/lawful-basis review and incident plan

Risk: Premature claims of learning impact
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Small pilot advertised as proven effectiveness
Prevention_and_Response: Report sample and limitations; test comprehension/usability first; separate self-report from observed performance
Required_Evidence: Pilot methods/results and claims audit

Risk: Biased civic or political content
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Tasks score beliefs, endorse a party or profile family views
Prevention_and_Response: Use neutral fictional cases and official procedure sources; assess evidence and respectful reasoning only
Required_Evidence: Independent civic-content review

Risk: Grant effort displaces product progress
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Closed or ineligible call treated as funding plan
Prevention_and_Response: Budget zero grants; check eligibility first and cap application effort; reject poor-fit calls
Required_Evidence: Eligibility note and documented application go/no-go

Risk: Wrong competent agency for a vocational variant
Stop_or_Review_Trigger: Book 3 vocational-subject materials treated as automatically within AZOO route
Prevention_and_Response: Obtain written AZOO/ASOO classification; separate variants and checklists where necessary; do not transfer annual deadlines
Required_Evidence: Written scope/jurisdiction confirmation and applicable dossier
